name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: The official app-store-style directory where Claude Code finds and installs plugins.
buyer: You don't buy this; you get listed in it. The opportunity belongs to developers who build a plugin worth listing and reach its large built-in audience.
business_use_cases: A tools startup ships a Claude Code plugin and gets discovered by every Claude Code user browsing the directory.
An agency builds a paid companion service around a free listed plugin (setup, support, custom skills).
A SaaS adds a plugin as a distribution channel, turning Claude Code users into signups.

money_ideas.idea: Build a genuinely useful plugin, list it free, and upsell a hosted or team version.
Offer 'we'll build and maintain your company's Claude Code plugin' as an agency service.

steal_this: Find one boring, repeated task your industry does in Claude Code, ship a small plugin for it this weekend, and get it into this directory before competitors notice.
